title: 5 Lakes Tour Louise and Moraine Emerald Peyto Takakkaw Falls
includes: Visit Marble Canyon only when Takakkaw Falls is closed
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Pack your own lunch or buy grab-to-go at Fairmont Café Lake Louise
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover the stunning landscapes of the Canadian Rockies on a tour that showcases 5 of its most iconic lakes. Experience the vibrant turquoise waters of Lake Louise and Moraine Lake, the enchanting scenery at Emerald Lake, the peaceful charm of Bow Lake, and the impressive vistas of Peyto Lake. This journey also features Takakkaw Falls, one of Canada's highest waterfalls, offering a remarkable blend of natural beauty and scenic grandeur. Perfect for nature lovers and photographers alike, this tour runs from mid-June to mid-October, ensuring the best conditions for exploration.

- Visit five iconic lakes including Lake Louise and Moraine Lake
- Capture breathtaking views at Takakkaw Falls, one of the highest in Canada
- Bow Lake, and the panoramic vistas of Peyto Lake
- Stunning views at Emerald Lake
